answer: A payout is split and as a result 50% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The grove schedule is applied in sable and ledge shows each instalment. An farming party as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3775 identities would post 1422 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
